title.zh: 整合影响：规则线网还不是最终图形
title.en: Integration: a regular grid is not the final pattern

subtitle.zh: Cut/Block / Line End / EPE / 图形转移
subtitle.en: Cut/block / line end / EPE / pattern transfer

body.zh: A：SADP 生成连续等距 Spacer 的规则密集线网。B：通过 Cut/Block 删除多余线段或定义线端。C：得到断开的线段和受控线端，并转移到硬掩膜或目标层。Cut/Block 负责图形编辑，不负责产生倍频。
body.en: A: SADP forms a dense regular grid of continuous, equally spaced spacers. B: cut/block removes unwanted segments or defines line ends. C: disconnected segments and controlled ends transfer to hard mask/target. Cut/block edits the pattern; it does not create density doubling.

body.zh: Cut CD 与 Block CD：满足删除效果与线端定义需求。Cut/Block overlay：控制与前层对准偏差。Line-End Bias：保证线端位置与形貌。下层形貌与图形转移：考虑下层形貌影响，保证正确转移到硬掩膜/目标层。
body.en: Cut/block CD must satisfy removal and line-end definition. Cut/block overlay controls alignment to prior layers. Line-end bias controls end position/profile. Underlying topography and transfer must support correct hard-mask/target replication.

body.zh: 规则线网与自对准关键边，需要与二维复杂度、Cut 数量、EPE 和设计限制权衡。漏切：应切未切，残留连接。过切：切除过多导致线段缺失。线端回缩：线端后退、尺寸偏小。桥连：相邻线段异常连接。Cut 残留：去除不完全，影响后续工艺。最终 CD 偏差：尺寸偏大或偏小。
body.en: Balance regular grids/self-aligned critical edges against 2D complexity, cut count, EPE, and design restrictions. Missed cuts leave connections; overcuts remove segments; end pullback shortens ends; bridges connect neighbors; incomplete cut removal leaves residue affecting later processing; final-CD bias produces oversized/undersized patterns.

body.zh: 关键边自对准不会消除 Cut/Block 与前层对准误差。量测 Cut/Block overlay、Tip-to-Tip、Line End、最终硬掩膜 CD、缺陷。反馈动作：图谱对齐 → 相关性判断 → 分片验证。
body.en: Self-aligned critical edges do not eliminate cut/block-to-prior-layer overlay error. Measure cut/block overlay, tip-to-tip, line ends, final hard-mask CD, and defects. Actions: align maps → assess correlations → validate splits.

body.zh: Cut/Block 曝光次数、插入顺序和材料体系随设计与整合方案变化。
body.en: Cut/block exposure count, sequence, and materials depend on design and integration scheme.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
